cuisine: Cuisine from the Aosta Valley, Classic Cuisine
bio: Founded in 1966 and now run by the fifth generation, the Lou Ressignon family trattoria (in local dialect the name translates as “the night snack”) serves authentic cuisine full of character which showcases the produce and traditions of the Aosta Valley. The dishes include a delicious Valpellinese soup and excellent tripe with borlotti beans and polentina. In addition to the first-floor dining room, there’s also a historic taverna, while four welcoming guestrooms are available for anyone wishing to extend their stay....
